{{Quote|The diagrams are taken from an After Action Report filed by General Rieekan after the Battle of Tiems.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]]|<ref name="The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
An '''after action Report''', or '''after-Action report''', was an analysis of combat engagements submitted by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] commanders following a battle. The report contained detailed information on the battle, allowing analysts to study the engagement. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] submitted an After Action Report following the [[Battle of Tiems]] that was used by General [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] in orientations of new ground commanders as an example of a textbook mobile defense tactic.
